label: Godot 4
description: Godot 4.3+ native glTF import (editor import or runtime GLTFDocument). Meters, +Y up, models face +Z (Vector3.MODEL_FRONT); no conversion needed.
importHints: Drop the .glb into the Godot FileSystem dock (or load it at runtime with GLTFDocument).
Godot imports 3D textures as VRAM Compressed by default (lossy). For pixel-exact palettes or crisp detail set the texture import mode to Lossless, or keep VRAM Compressed with High Quality.
Base color factors map to StandardMaterial3D.albedo_color (converted to sRGB by the importer).

notes: engines/godot/verify/verify_golden.gd checks every golden GLB headless (AABB, origin, triangles, surfaces, albedo, metal/rough, transparency, culling).
Godot binaries could not be downloaded in the build container, so the script must be run once on a machine with Godot 4.3+.
